LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD is a standard CMake-based package for the ButterflyPACK scientific library. It fetches source from the official GitHub repository with a pinned version tag and verified SHA256 checksums. The prepare() function applies a local patch for PaRSEC CMake configuration and uses sed to fix installation paths (moving examples out of /usr/lib/EXAMPLE and Python modules into site-packages), which are routine packaging adjustments. The build() uses the project's own CMake configuration with MPI and OpenMP enabled, linking against system BLAS/LAPACK/ScaLAPACK/ZFP/FFTW. The check() runs the upstream test suite via a provided .ci_tests.sh script. The package() installs via CMake, includes the license, and compiles Python bytecode. No network access, obfuscation, eval, base64, data exfiltration, or execution of untrusted code is present. All operations are consistent with legitimate AUR packaging practices for a high-performance computing library.
</details>
<evidence>
